epic.title: Extend the greeting service
epic.body:
## Summary

Grow the greeting service from one route to a small, tested API.

## Sub-issues

{{checklist}}

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every sub-issue is closed.
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes on `main`.

issues.title: Add a /version endpoint
issues.body:
## Summary

Add `GET /version` to `app.py`. It returns the service version.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /version` answers 200 with `{"version": "0.1.0"}`.
- [ ] A test covers the route.

issues.title: Reject an empty name at /hello/
issues.body:
## Summary

`GET /hello/` greets an empty name today. It must answer an error instead.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /hello/` answers 400 with `{"error": "name required"}`.
- [ ] A test covers the case.

issues.title: Read the port from a --port option
issues.body:
## Summary

The service always listens on port 8000. Let the operator choose the port.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python3 app.py --port 9000` listens on port 9000.
- [ ] Without the option, the service listens on port 8000.
- [ ] A test covers the option parser.

issues.title: Log each request on one line
issues.body:
## Summary

Write one line to stderr for each request: the method, the path, and the status.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A request to `/health` writes `GET /health 200` to stderr.
- [ ] A test covers the log line.

issues.title: Document the routes in the README
issues.body:
## Summary

The README names no route. List each route with an example reply.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `README.md` has a `Routes` section.
- [ ] The section lists every route that `app.py` serves.
